reviews.title: Solid cooler for the price.
reviews.comment: It does what it should, install was simple enough but I know what I'm doing. Controlling it with signal RGB. Pump isn't loud but I'm running it at lower RPM because 4500 rpm is unnecessary. It would be loud if you left it maxed out for no reason. Seeing the coolant move around when it's booting up is pretty cool. Once you get fully going and the block full of coolant the effect is minimal.
reviews.author: Chris
